title: CLAUDE.md
text: CarletonStats R package providing bootstrapping, permutation tests, grouped bar plots, statistical demos introductory statistics courses (Stat 120 Carleton College). published CRAN.

title: CLAUDE.md
code: # Load the package during development devtools::load_all()  # Run all tests devtools::test()  # Run a single test file testthat::test_file("tests/testthat/test-Carl.R")  # Rebuild documentation from roxygen2 comments devtools::document()  # Full R CMD check (what CRAN runs) devtools::check()  # Check without rebuilding vignettes (faster) devtools::check(vignettes = FALSE)  # Install locally devtools::install()

title: CLAUDE.md
text: Every major function (boot, bootCor, bootPaired, bootSlope, permTest, permTestAnova, permTestCor, permTestPaired, permTestSlope, groupedBar, stemPlot) follows three-file pattern: R/<fn>.R — defines generic via UseMethod(); holds roxygen2 docs @export R/<fn>.default.R — implements vector/default interface (takes raw vectors arguments) R/<fn>.formula.R — implements formula interface (y ~ group, data = ...), parses formula, delegates .default method

title: CLAUDE.md
text: Bootstrap functions return numeric vector resampled statistics S3 class carlboot. metadata (observed statistic, group names, CI level, plot flags, etc.) stored attributes vector. Permutation functions return numeric vector S3 class carlperm, also using attributes metadata (observed statistic, p-value, alternative, group stats, plot flags, etc.). classes print, plot, summary, (carlboot) confint methods R/print.R, R/plot.R, R/summary.R, R/confint.R. Printing triggers plotting: print.carlboot print.carlperm call plot() plot.hist = TRUE (default), use patchwork::wrap_plots plot.hist plot.qq requested.

title: CLAUDE.md
text: permutation functions share internal helper .calc_pvalue() R/pvalue.R. uses +1 adjustment (count + 1) / (B + 1) avoid p-values exactly 0.

title: CLAUDE.md
text: Plots ggplot2-based (using ggplot2, scales, patchwork). plot.carlboot plot.carlperm methods R/plot.R render histograms resampling distribution observed mean statistics marked points.

title: CLAUDE.md
text: Docs generated roxygen2 (version 7.2.3). generic’s .R file carries @param tags @examples; .default .formula files use @describeIn <generic> attach docs. Run devtools::document() editing roxygen comments — never hand-edit man/ NAMESPACE.

title: CLAUDE.md
text: Three built-datasets live data/ .rda files: Icecream, Milkshakes, states03. Documentation R/Data.R.

title: CLAUDE.md
text: Always run air format . generating code Use base pipe operator (|>) magrittr pipe (%>%) Don’t use _$x _$[["x"]] since dbplyr must work R 4.1. Use \() ... single-line anonymous functions. cases, use function() {...}

title: CLAUDE.md
text: Tests R/{name}.R go tests/testthat/test-{name}.R. new code accompanying test. existing tests, place new tests next similar existing tests. Strive keep tests minimal comments.

title: CLAUDE.md
text: Every user-facing function exported roxygen2 documentation. Wrap roxygen comments 80 characters. Internal functions roxygen documentation. Whenever add new (non-internal) documentation topic, also add topic _pkgdown.yml. Use pkgdown::check_pkgdown() check topics included reference index.

title: CLAUDE.md
text: Every user-facing change given bullet NEWS.md. add bullets small documentation changes internal refactorings. bullet briefly describes change end user, mention related issue parentheses. bullet can consist multiple sentences contain new lines (.e. don’t wrap bullet). change related function, put name function early bullet. Order bullets alphabetically function name. Put bullets don’t mention function names beginning.

title: CLAUDE.md
text: Use sentence case headings. Use US English.

title: CarletonStats 2.3
text: boot() permTest() now accept logical, factor, character response variables exactly two levels. new success argument specifies level coded 1 (proportion). message confirms coding chosen. bootPaired() computed paired difference x - y, inconsistent permTestPaired()’s y - x; now use y - x, permTestPaired()’s printed group means, mislabeled, now show correct name next mean. permTestCor() permTestPaired() seed argument silently ignored, making results non-reproducible. seed argument now correctly sets random seed permutation loop. Minimum R version now declared R (>= 3.5.0) minimum ggplot2 version 3.3.0 DESCRIPTION.

title: CarletonStats 2.2
text: CRAN release: 2023-08-22 boot*() functions now return bootstrap statistics carlboot object, print, plot, summary, confint methods. permTest*() functions now return bootstrap statistics carlperm object, print, plot, summary methods. Additional arguments added boot*() permTest*() functions:xlab,ylab,title,seed`. arguments deleted boot*() functions: legend.loc (just use ggplot2 theme needed), hist.title (now use title) plots generated boot*() permTest*() functions now rendered via ggplot2.
